name: agent
description: Student agent that connects to the exam-live WebSocket gateway, joins an exam session, and creates the declared submission files on this machine. Electron app (electron/, driven by src/session-controller.ts) — src/cli.ts, the terminal prototype this replaced, was deleted once parity was confirmed against it (design spec 2026-09-01-student-agent-electron-design.md §8.4).

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p electron/tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p electron/renderer/tsconfig.json
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:electron && electron-builder --win portable
